counting_note: Master entries are family-local records. Mass profiles are family instances, not distinct graph topologies.
limits: Bounded one-loop and two-loop constructions. Dataset size does not establish model accuracy or high-loop generalization.
optimality: Recorded valid reductions; minimum seed and operation counts are not established.
split_policy: Complete kinematic equality/zero profiles grouped across all mass assignments. Initial validation bubble and triangle reassigned to training because they occur as lower sectors of expanded training families.
topology_coverage: 997 original one-loop families and 3 original two-loop families; 100 previously added profiles at orders 2..12, 250 earlier profiles and 1,000 new profiles at each order 1..12 in the restricted coupled vacuum domain.
